headline.description: One sentence of at most 30 words on what stood out in this period.

themes.description: Recurring topics, each shared by at least two feedback items.

name.description: 3 to 7 words that state the topic specifically.

type.description: One of: bug, feature_request, usability, performance, pricing, praise, other.

feedback_ids.description: The id of every feedback item in this theme.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences on what these customers are saying. No counts, percentages or quotes.

suggested_action.description: One concrete next step for the product team, starting with a verb.

quote_id.description: The id of the single item that best represents the theme.
